items.title: Javonte Green reflected fondly on breaking into the NBA with the Celtics. His journey was far from traditional, but Boston welcomed him with open arms.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Javonte Green reflected fondly on breaking into the NBA with the Celtics. His journey was far from traditional, but Boston welcomed him with open arms.

"The hospitality...I wasn't a traditional rookie...Them teaching me how to get adjusted to the league...It was a great feeling."

items.author: KeithSmithNBA

Pistons got back in the game with a barrage of Javonte Green threes. Now, it's Duncan Robinson with a triple avalanche in the fourth quarter.

Detroit is on an 18-0 run to take a 107-99 lead with 5:10 to play. A lot of threes and free throws against disconnected Boston defense.

items.title: Javonte Green has been a game-changer in the 3rd Qtr.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Javonte Green has been a game-changer in the 3rd Qtr.

After not playing in the first half, he has 11 points on 3/5 shooting.

The Pistons having more spacing and shooting on the floor has them within six after being down by 22. They've brought this crowd to life.
